scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
